column3: Close to the Hebrew; “until he takes pleasure in his day” is rendered “Till … he finishes his day.”
Close to the Hebrew; וַיֶּחֱלָשׁ (“is laid low”) is rendered “is laid away.”
Close to the Hebrew; בִּשְׁאוֹל (“Sheol”) is rendered “the grave.”
Close to the Hebrew; “will he live?” is rendered “shall he live again?” and חֲלִיפָתִי (“my relief”) “my change.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you have smeared over” is rendered “You cover.”
